mechanism_narrative: A federal funds rate below 4.0% indicates accommodative monetary policy that reduces discount rates for equity valuation, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days when the signal is active.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in > 60% of instances when FEDFUNDS < 4.0%.

mechanism_narrative: A current unemployment rate exceeding 4.2% signals labor market deterioration that reduces corporate hiring and earnings growth, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 5d returns in < 40% of instances when UNRATE > 4.2%.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous rising unemployment rate and declining industrial production indicate severe economic contraction, triggering negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days through reduced corporate investment.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20d returns in < 40% of instances when UNRATE rises and INDPRO falls.

mechanism_narrative: During monetary tightening cycles (FEDFUNDS > 4.0%), higher discount rates suppress equity valuations, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 60d returns in > 60% of instances when FEDFUNDS > 4.0%.

mechanism_narrative: Housing starts above 1500 thousand units signal strong consumer demand and economic expansion, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days through elevated corporate revenue expectations.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in < 40% of instances when HOUST > 1500.

mechanism_narrative: Industrial production below 103.0 (index 2017=100) indicates manufacturing contraction that reduces corporate output and profits, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 5d returns in < 40% of instances when INDPRO < 103.0.

mechanism_narrative: Concurrent slowing job growth (PAYEMS 3-month change < 0) and rising unemployment rate (UNRATE 3-month change > 0) signal labor market stress that depresses consumer spending and equity returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20d returns in < 40% of instances when PAYEMS growth slows and UNRATE rises.

mechanism_narrative: Industrial production above 103.5 (index 2017=100) indicates robust manufacturing activity that supports corporate earnings growth, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 60d returns in < 40% of instances when INDPRO > 103.5.
